systemdFinding: A first attempt used Environment= in a systemd drop-in and silently did nothing: systemd gives EnvironmentFile= precedence over Environment= regardless of drop-in order, so /etc/migrapilot/brain.env always won. systemctl show reported the variable as set, which made it look applied. The decisive check was the model catalog: 16 -> 1. Use an EnvironmentFile listed last, never Environment=, to override a value that an env file sets.
